rep.partial_message: Reach your arms all the way overhead.

checks.label: Feet too close
checks.message: Jump your feet wider than your shoulders.

checks.label: Arms not overhead
checks.message: Reach your arms all the way overhead.

camera.title: Face the camera
steps: Prop your phone or laptop 2.5 to 3 m away at chest height, with you facing it.
Stand far enough back that both hands stay in frame at the top of every rep.
Light the room from the front or above. A bright window behind you makes the camera lose your outline.
Wear fitted clothing so your shoulders and elbows are visible.
camera.note: Stand 3 m from the camera facing it, with your hands and feet in frame at full stretch.

guidance.accuracy: This is a warm-up helper with simple rules. It counts reps and flags the most common mistakes, nothing more.
